findingsDelta.evidence: PR synchronize run 32534531824 proved that the historical base workflow could re-enter from an ordinary PR synchronization with contents:write, DEV credential, protected Drive download, 35-file source apply and push to the live branch. The observed run stopped only on a historical SHA mismatch before apply/commit; that mismatch is not a safety control. Current-conversation emergency authorization replaced the base workflow in fc7ead694ccdb01bee79856d47a761d34c8d88b9 with contents:read, no push/pull_request trigger, no secrets/download/apply/commit/push/deploy, and an if:false job.

The request remains enabled=true without consumed terminal semantics. The workflow has contents:write, loads the DEV service-account credential, performs live HR/provider reads and can commit sanitized evidence plus the HR tab registry to the live branch. It does not bind execution to the current continuity lock/consumed ledger before credential access or repository mutation.

rootCauseProgress.finding: RC15 now proves a seventh control-plane failure mode: execution authority can survive in the PR base branch and re-enter on pull_request synchronization even when the workflow has already disappeared from the live head. This joins provider/source/state authority drift, request/lock bypass, direct legacy connectivity, external-HR authority gaps and trigger/request/executor binding defects.
rootCauseProgress.fixModel: The proven V156 PR-base writer is contained. Continue exhaustive F0. F1 must atomically tombstone remaining historical write/read-state authorities; F2 must enforce master plan + continuity lock + consumed ledger/current read authorization before credentials, provider/external-HR/legacy access or repository mutation. Only afterward revalidate G2-B under a new explicit one-shot authorization.

toolingIncidents.description: During emergency containment an atomic tree and commit object d2a3edf6377b130f3b6206959f4a42eb31b3aee7 was prepared but not referenced. The authorized branch change was then applied as single-file commit fc7ead694ccdb01bee79856d47a761d34c8d88b9. The dangling commit has no ref and no branch/provider side effect.
